description: Independent question set: written as a business manager would ask, covering all areas, then classified. NOT fully independent: written by the developer who designed the catalog (see method). expect=answer: ground truth from hand-written SQL using the question's natural meaning; expect=refuse: kind 'gap' (data exists but the catalog cannot answer) or 'impossible' (no such data, causes, forecasts).
method: Questions drafted per business area as a manager would phrase them, then classified. Deliberately includes wording that is not in the catalog's term lists and traps where a plausible-looking answer is wrong. Add your own questions in the same format to make the set more independent.

questions.question: Which month in 2017 had the highest sales?
questions.note: Sales = item revenue; months within the reliable window.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT year_month, ROUND(SUM(items_price_total), 2) AS revenue FROM analytics.sales_daily WHERE year = 2017 AND in_candidate_window GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What was our total turnover in 2017?
questions.note: Turnover = item revenue for the whole year.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(items_price_total), 2) AS revenue FROM analytics.sales_daily WHERE year = 2017

questions.question: How much did we sell in the state of Sao Paulo?
questions.note: Needs a filter on one state; the catalog groups but cannot filter by value.

questions.question: Which states buy the most products?
questions.note: Units bought by customer state; 'products' is not a listed term.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.customer_state_std, SUM(l.quantity) AS units FROM warehouse.fact_order_lines l JOIN warehouse.fact_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What were the takings by product category?
questions.note: 'Takings' = revenue; not a listed term.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT category_reporting, items_price_total FROM analytics.category_performance ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Show me the revenue trend for 2018.
questions.note: Monthly revenue in 2018 (reliable window).
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT year_month, ROUND(SUM(items_price_total), 2) AS revenue FROM analytics.sales_daily WHERE year = 2018 AND in_candidate_window GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Which category earns the least?
questions.note: 'Earns' = revenue; lowest first.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT category_reporting, items_price_total FROM analytics.category_performance ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many unique customers did we have in 2018?
questions.note: Distinct customers with an order purchased in 2018.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM warehouse.fact_orders WHERE purchase_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND purchase_date < DATE '2019-01-01'

questions.question: Which states have the most customers?
questions.note: Distinct customers per customer state.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state_std, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM warehouse.fact_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What share of customers come back for a second purchase?
questions.note: Repeat-customer rate exists in the data (is_repeat_customer) but not in the catalog.

questions.question: How many new customers did we acquire each month in 2017?
questions.note: NEW customers = first purchase in that month (cohort size). Counting all active customers per month would be wrong.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM warehouse.dim_customers WHERE cohort_month LIKE '2017-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled?
questions.note: Cancelled orders (625) exist in the data, but the catalog has no status filter. Answering with all orders would be wrong.

questions.question: What is the average delivery time in days?
questions.note: Average purchase-to-delivery days over delivered orders with a delivery date.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(purchase_to_delivery_days)::numeric, 2) AS days FROM warehouse.fact_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Which states wait the longest for their deliveries?
questions.note: Average delivery days per customer state; wording not in the term lists.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state_std, avg_purchase_to_delivery_days FROM analytics.delivery_by_state ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: In which month of 2018 were deliveries most often late?
questions.note: Late delivery rate per purchase month in 2018.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT purchase_year_month, late_rate FROM analytics.delivery_monthly WHERE purchase_year_month BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-08' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Do late deliveries hurt customer ratings?
questions.note: Average review score for late vs on-time deliveries.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.is_late THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS score FROM warehouse.fact_reviews r JOIN warehouse.fact_orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How often are orders delivered after the promised date?
questions.note: Overall late delivery rate; wording not in the term lists.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late)::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) AS late_rate FROM warehouse.fact_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

questions.question: What is the most popular payment method?
questions.note: Popularity = number of payments; ranking by payment VALUE answers a different measure.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payments FROM warehouse.fact_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: How much did customers pay in total with vouchers?
questions.note: Needs a filter on one payment type.

questions.question: What is the average number of installments for credit card payments?
questions.note: Installments are in the data but not in the catalog.

questions.question: What's the average customer rating?
questions.note: Average review score over all reviews.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) AS score FROM warehouse.fact_reviews

questions.question: Which month of 2017 had the worst reviews?
questions.note: Lowest average score first; a list led by the best month would be wrong.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT to_char(purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) AS score FROM warehouse.fact_reviews WHERE in_candidate_window AND purchase_date >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND purchase_date < DATE '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many reviews did we receive in 2018?
questions.note: Received = review creation date in 2018 (the catalog counts reviews by purchase date).
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM warehouse.fact_reviews WHERE review_creation_date >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND review_creation_date < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'

questions.question: What is our profit margin by category?
questions.note: No cost data: profit cannot be computed.

questions.question: Which marketing campaign drove the most sales in 2018?
questions.note: No marketing data.

questions.question: How many products do we currently have in stock?
questions.note: No inventory data.

questions.question: What will sales look like next quarter?
questions.note: Forecast.

questions.question: Why did revenue drop in June 2018?
questions.note: Causes cannot be determined from the data.

questions.question: Who are our top 10 customers by spend?
questions.note: Individual customers are in the data but not in the catalog.

questions.question: Which sellers generate the most revenue?
questions.note: Individual sellers (not seller states) are not in the catalog.

questions.question: What was the revenue in Rio de Janeiro in 2017?
questions.note: Needs a filter on one state. Answering with total 2017 revenue would be wrong.

questions.question: Which product sold the most units?
questions.note: Individual products are not in the catalog.
